songs.title: If I Didn't Have It ⚙️
lines: If I didn't have a stapler,
I would use some tape instead.
If I didn't have a remote,
I would walk to the TV.
They save time and effort too!
n: 곡조: Oh My Darling, Clementine (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
stapler에서 손으로 찍는 흉내, remote에서 리모컨 누르는 흉내를 화면에 보여주기
songs.imgPrompt: Kids at school desks using a stapler, tape and a zipper bag, with a rice cooker and remote control nearby.
